entities.name: Zhang Hanlan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zhang Hanlan is a female Chinese basketball player. She was part of the teams that won gold medals at the 2002 Asian Games and the 2010 Asian Games. Zhang also competed for China at the 2008 Summer Olympics where the team came in fourth place.
